name: No Inclusive Translations
author: Kerfred

sections.description:
For the French WordPress users that don’t like the translations that appeared on WordPress 5.6 (like translating “users” by “comptes”, this plugin will cancel these translations and revert back to the previous translations.

Major features include:

  • Revert back the translation of “user” to “utilisateur”
  • Remove the gendered roles translations: “administratrice”, “éditrice”, “autrice”, “contributrice”, “abonnée”
  • Remove the midpoint and inclusive translations
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin in the Admin => Plugins menu => Add New => Upload => Select the zip file => Install Now
  2. Activate the plugin
